zh.title: 捷藍航空發表區域頭等艙BlueFirst 預計9月起改裝空中巴士機隊
zh.summary: 捷藍航空發表國內頭等艙BlueFirst；預計2028年前完成客艙改裝。
body: 美國捷藍航空（JetBlue）正式發表名為「BlueFirst」的全新區域頭等艙產品，標誌著該航空公司首次在其無機載「Mint」商務艙的國內航線上推出傳統頭等艙座椅。這項新產品將首度引進至捷藍航空未配置Mint商務艙的空中巴士A220、空中巴士A320（ICAO機型代碼A320）以及空中巴士A321（ICAO機型代碼A321）客機機隊，為廣大國內線旅客提供更高等級的搭乘選擇與舒適體驗。
根據捷藍航空公佈的規劃與相關監管進展，該營運項目已取得美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）的認證。首架客機的艙房改裝工程預定於2026年9月21日正式展開，並預計於2028年前完成全機隊的改裝作業。全新BlueFirst客艙產品預計於2026年稍晚開始投入實際航班營運，相關機位預訂服務則規劃於今年秋季正式對外開放。
在座椅硬體規格方面，BlueFirst客艙採用每排兩座位的「二對二」（2-2）配置，規劃於客艙前方二至四排。新座椅具備5英吋傾斜角度，並提供較標準經濟艙增加多達7英吋的腿部伸展空間。此外，該座椅特別選用由床墊製造商Tuft & Needle開發的T&N Flex專利泡棉，以提升乘客在飛行過程中的支撐力與舒適度。
客艙娛樂與個人設備方面，每張BlueFirst座椅皆配備13.3吋個人視訊螢幕，支援藍牙無線耳機連接功能，並附設USB-A、USB-C充電埠與110伏特標準電源插座。旅客可透過個人螢幕使用「座艙點餐」系統選購餐點與調酒，且飛行距離達899英哩（含）以上的航班將提供包含主餐、副餐與甜點的便當風格餐盒。所有BlueFirst乘客並可繼續享有免費Fly-Fi高速機上Wi-Fi網路服務。
購買BlueFirst機票的旅客將享有優質的地勤與搭機服務，包括第1組優先登機、專屬頭等艙頂棚行李置物空間、優先辦理報到手續，以及在超過30座機場使用快速安檢通道。此外，乘客亦可享有兩件免費托運行李及行李優先提領服務。捷藍航空執行長Joanna Geraghty表示，國內頭等艙市場需要創新，客戶對高階體驗的需求持續成長，BlueFirst將為旅客提供兼具精緻服務與高價值的升級體驗。

en.title: JetBlue Unveils BlueFirst Domestic First Class Cabin With Fleet Retrofit by 2028
en.summary: JetBlue unveils its new BlueFirst domestic first-class cabin, planning full fleet retrofits by 2028.
body: JetBlue has unveiled "BlueFirst," its first traditional domestic first-class cabin, marking a major product shift for the carrier as it introduces dedicated first-class seating across its broader domestic network. The new cabin will be retrofitted across JetBlue's aircraft fleet that do not feature its flagship lie-flat Mint business class, specifically targeting its Airbus A220, Airbus A320 (ICAO type code A320), and Airbus A321 (ICAO type code A321) narrowbody aircraft.

With Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) certification already secured, the airline is scheduled to begin its first aircraft modification on September 21, 2026. JetBlue aims to complete a full fleet retrofit by 2028. Flights featuring the new BlueFirst product are scheduled to commence later in 2026, with customer ticket bookings set to open in the fall. The carrier noted that details regarding specific inaugural routes, fares, and initial aircraft types will be released later this year.

The BlueFirst cabin design features recliner seats arranged in a two-by-two configuration spanning two to four rows depending on the aircraft type. The seats offer five inches of recline and up to seven inches of additional legroom compared to JetBlue's main cabin seating. To maximize passenger comfort, the seats incorporate custom-designed T&N Flex foam developed in partnership with mattress manufacturer Tuft & Needle, along with adjustable headrests and high-backed privacy shells.

In terms of inflight technology and amenities, each seat is equipped with a 13.3-inch seatback entertainment screen featuring Bluetooth headphone connectivity, USB-A and USB-C charging ports, and a standard 110-volt power outlet. Passengers can utilize seatback screen ordering for onboard food and drinks, including a "Mixologist Mode" for custom beverage orders. On flights covering at least 899 miles, JetBlue will serve bento-style meals, complemented by free access to the airline's high-speed Fly-Fi internet service.

Passengers traveling in the BlueFirst cabin will receive premium ground and airport privileges, including Group 1 priority boarding, dedicated overhead bin space, priority check-in, and access to expedited security lanes at more than 30 airports. The ticket includes two free checked bags with priority baggage delivery services. JetBlue Chief Executive Officer Joanna Geraghty stated that customers are increasingly seeking premium travel experiences, and that BlueFirst offers an elevated product tailored to deliver strong customer value.
